name: د. محمود بن حليم
notes: Verse numbers, words and headings come from the PDF text layer (sources/qasim.pdf); timings from pause analysis + dynamic programming + whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo transcript matching (no Turath).
Each app file begins with the spoken surah/bab title (about 1.5-5 s); it is not part of any verse. Verse 1121 (first of باب التكبير) starts about 1.4 s after the cut.
Sections 61 (القصص) and 62 (العنكبوت): the reciter does not announce سورة العنكبوت, so the cut is placed at the pause between verses 951 and 952.
Cuts for الأنعام (1610.5), الأعراف (2020.63) and الأنفال start (2304.76) are the owner-given ones, kept exactly.

Several verses (e.g. 674, 1016, 1017, 1149, 1150) have damaged or abjad-letter text in the PDF text layer, so their whisper match is low; their timing follows the pause/length fit and neighbours that match well.
No repeated, skipped or inserted verse was detected: every section's verse count fit its duration at about 0.2 s per letter.
Section ids follow the literal order of the PDF table of contents (entries 2-4 النسخ المعتمدة / رموز القراء / الأضداد are counted). If the text agent excluded them, ids shift by 3.

2026-10-21: verses 672–675, 797, 1015–1017, 1031–1032 and 1173 corrected by hand. The automatic fit had set boundaries at the middle of verses, inside a spoken chapter title, or after the closing words «تم بحمد الله». The fix was checked with a whisper word-level transcript and snapped to the pause between verses.

2026-11-03 run 3: verses 1-444 (sections 5-33, source files 01-29, one file per section) added. Word-anchored alignment (whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo words -> verse-level DP on PDF word sets and letter lengths -> boundary snapped to the pause between the words), spoken titles and non-verse speech excluded first; times are speech edges. File 01 (مقدمة الناظم) starts with the book title and editor credits; its audio is trimmed to start just before the bismillah (sourceStart 47.82 s). Several verses in the code-letter sections (ذكر ذال إذ ... ) have damaged PDF text, so their whisper match is low; see timing-report-usul.md.
